_comment: Physical ambient LEDs (WLED) driven by the scene lighting model. Disabled by default — set enabled=true and point host at your WLED controller (IP preferred, or an mDNS name like wled.local). led_count + layout describe the square of strips above the play area, walked clockwise from top-left; realtime streams one colour per LED over UDP (ddp | dnrgb) for smooth/directional effects, otherwise Tier-1 HTTP pushes a single solid colour. See scripts/wled_controller.gd and DESIGN.md §8 (v0.16).
